typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		member_id as string,
		enrollment_request_id as string,
		reporting_segment as string,
		enrollment_event_type as string,
		enrollment_filename as string,
		error_reason as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of enrollment_filename} = toString(enrollment_filename),
		{Copy of member_id} = toString(member_id),
		{Copy of enrollment_request_id} = toString(enrollment_request_id),
		{Copy of error_reason} = toString(error_reason),
		{Copy of enrollment_event_type} = toString(enrollment_event_type),
		{Copy of reporting_segment} = toString(reporting_segment)) ~> DataConversion
